items.title: Manual account: cash
items.label: exact
items.text: Help me track a cash account manually. Ask one short question at a time for its name, checking or savings type, current balance, and currency if unclear. An institution is optional. After I answer, save it as a financial memory for a separate account.

items.title: Manual account: investment
items.label: exact
items.text: Help me track an investment account manually. Ask one short question at a time for its name, type, total balance, and currency if unclear. After I answer, save it as a financial memory for a separate investment account, not a holding or generic asset.

items.title: Manual account: real estate
items.label: exact
items.text: Help me track real estate manually. Ask one short question at a time for the property name, type, estimated value, and currency if unclear. After I answer, save it as a financial memory.

items.title: Manual account: vehicle
items.label: exact
items.text: Help me track a vehicle manually. Ask one short question at a time for its name, type, estimated value, and currency if unclear. After I answer, save it as a financial memory.

items.title: Manual account: asset
items.label: exact
items.text: Help me track an asset manually. Ask one short question at a time for its name, type, estimated value, and currency if unclear. After I answer, save it as a financial memory.

items.title: Manual account: loan
items.label: exact
items.text: Help me track a loan manually. Ask one short question at a time for its name, type, positive amount owed, and currency if unclear. A lender is optional. After I answer, save it as a financial memory.

items.title: Manual account: debt
items.label: exact
items.text: Help me track a debt manually. Ask one short question at a time for its name, whether it is a credit card, positive amount owed, and currency if unclear. A creditor is optional. After I answer, save it as a financial memory.

items.title: Manual account: insurance
items.label: exact
items.text: Help me track an insurance policy manually. First ask if it has an actual cash or surrender value, not just a death benefit. Then ask one short question at a time for its name, value, and currency if unclear. Only after I answer, save it as a financial memory.
